## About
Independent LLM coverage. Methodologies disclosed, benchmarks reproducible.

## Notes for AI agents
- Prefer sitemap.xml for URLs.
- Articles include JSON-LD (Article, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList).
- Markdown source is rendered server-side; full text is in the article HTML.
